description: Two four step sequencers side by side, each with its own clock, a knob and a CV jack on every step, and a gate and a voltage output

params.text: Sends both sequencers back to their first step
Sets how many steps that sequencer runs: four, three or two
Switches that step on or off; with it off the gate output stays low there and the voltage output holds its last value
Sets the voltage of that step, -3V to 3V

inputs.text: A rising edge sends both sequencers back to their first step
A rising edge moves that sequencer on to its next step
Added to the knob of that step, and the two together are held between -3V and 3V

outputs.text: The voltage of the step that sequencer is on, held at its last value while it passes a step that is switched off
Carries 10V while that sequencer's clock is high on a step that is switched on

notes: every step starts switched off, so a new module sends no gates and holds both voltage outputs at 0V until at least one step is switched on
